events.description: A person in a dark jacket holds a handgun pointed at a chef who is raising both hands in surrender against a refrigerator; the gun is clearly aimed and the posture indicates an imminent or ongoing shooting.

A person with a braided ponytail, holding a firearm, confronts and coerces a chef in a kitchen; the chef raises hands in submission (visible from f3 onward), indicating a coercive, threatening situation where the victim is helpless.

A person in a white chef's uniform is seen raising both hands against a refrigerator while another person (with long braid) holds a silver handgun pointed toward them; the posture and context strongly indicate an active shooting threat or imminent discharge.
A person with a long braid holds a handgun and confronts a chef who is visibly surrendering (hands up, pressed against refrigerator), indicating coercion of a helpless victim in a confined space.

A man in a patterned shirt stands over a subdued, kneeling individual, holding a knife and displaying aggressive posture; the victim appears helpless and injured (visible blood on hand in f7), consistent with ongoing physical abuse.

A man in a black patterned shirt is physically assaulting another man who is on the ground; he bends over him, grabs his collar/neck area, and maintains control while the victim shows visible injuries (blood on face, lip) and distress.

Two men are engaged in close-quarters physical combat: one is grabbing the other's neck/collar while the other appears to be resisting or counter-grappling; facial expressions show strain and aggression.

One man is clearly subdued, on the ground or bent over, with visible facial injuries (bloody lip, swelling), while the other maintains control by gripping his neck/shoulder; the victim appears helpless and unable to resist.
Two men are engaged in close physical confrontation; one is leaning over the other with intense facial expressions and proximity suggesting mutual aggression or struggle.
One man is shown gripping the back of the other's neck/collar, forcing his head down while the victim appears restrained and distressed—indicating a one-sided attack on a vulnerable individual.
Two men engage in a physical fight in an alley; one man in dark clothing is seen striking or grappling with another man in a patterned shirt, who is on the ground.
The man in the patterned shirt lies on the ground, appearing incapacitated, while the other man continues to assault him—grabbing, punching, and pressing down—indicating abuse of a helpless victim.

A third individual (wearing a headband and maroon jacket) intervenes, attacking the first aggressor with a rolling pin; the original victim remains on the ground as the new combatant engages the attacker.
A woman in a maroon cardigan and white tank top is engaged in physical combat with at least two opponents in an alley; she swings a wooden bat-like object while standing over fallen adversaries.

A man (Jason Statham) lying on the ground among trash aims a handgun directly toward the camera; his arm is extended, finger on trigger, and muzzle is visible pointing forward — consistent with active firing or imminent discharge.
The woman continues to swing the bat at retreating opponents; one opponent stumbles backward while another flees, indicating ongoing physical confrontation.
A person lying on the ground fires a handgun toward two individuals running away down the alley; muzzle flash is visible in frame f2.
The man who was lying down gets up and engages in physical combat with another individual near the trash bins; visible grappling and falling motion across frames f13–f15.
